seasons.winter: Nov-Feb (winter Y = Nov-Dec of Y-1 + Jan-Feb of Y)

values: chg_ft = kriged change in areal-mean water-level elevation from base_year (ft, + = rising); se_chg_ft = its standard error, calibrated (95% range = +-1.96 se); wle_ft/se_ft = level and its standard error
data: NM Unified Water Data API (pulled 2026-11-01) + NMBGMR open-file-report readings missing from the API; land elevation from the API, USGS 3DEP where missing
method: Spatiotemporal regression kriging after Rawling (NMBGMR OFR-616), one model per HUC-8 and season; see kriged/README.md
